name: attend-slack-notifications
description: Cloudflare Worker that posts to Slack whenever someone new signs up for a Hack Club Attend event.

ATTEND_TOKEN.description: An Attend mobile token. In BetterAttend: Settings → Developer → Copy a new mobile token. The worker rotates it automatically.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Slack incoming webhook URL to post sign-ups to (https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks).

ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional. Any long random string; enables the /status, /poll, /test and /reset endpoints.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A separate Slack webhook for 'token expired' alerts. Defaults to SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

ATTEND_EVENT.description: Event slug or ID, as in attend.hackclub.com/admin/<slug>. Comma-separate several.

SUMMARY_TEMPLATE.description: Message used when more people signed up at once than MAX_MESSAGES_PER_POLL. Placeholders: {new_count} {count} {event} {event_url}.
